rules.source_quote: The age of the applicant should be 18 years and above.
The age of the applicant should be 18 years and above.
rules.note: SOURCE CONFLICT, needs human sign-off. NSAP FAQ Q20 (official) says 18-59 years; IGNDPS-IN-BENEFIT-01 and IGNDPSM-MH say 18-79. Set to 79 to match IGNWPS-IN-R02, pending the official NSAP guidelines PDF. See POLICY.md §2.

rules.source_quote: The applicant should be a resident of India.
rules.note: Residency is not explicitly stated in the NSAP FAQ (Q20). The passage is flagged needs_recollection. This rule should be re-verified against an official NSAP source that explicitly states a residency or citizenship requirement.

rules.source_quote: The applicant should be a physically or mentally disabled person.
Any disabled person whose age is more than 18 years, and with disability 80% or more belonging to the poverty line can apply for this scheme.
rules.note: Resolved to 80% or more (inclusive) by Priyanka (gold-set owner) 2026-11-10; confirmed by Vivian 2026-11-12. NSAP FAQ (Q20) states 'severe or multiple disabilities'; the 80% threshold is derived from RPwD Act 2016 Section 2(r). Discovery reference: https://web.umang.gov.in/landing/scheme/detail/indira-gandhi-national-disability-pension-scheme_igndps.html (UMANG, discovery only per POLICY.md §3).
